# Compatibility fallback

This file is retained only for standalone compatibility. In the integrated repository, the only runtime visual style source is `visual/ACTIVE-STYLE.md`.

Create a calm, refined and content-led senior-leadership briefing body image with an ivory background, restrained deep-blue emphasis, Microsoft YaHei-like Chinese typography, one dominant business anchor and one clear visual center. Follow the supplied page-level visual structure contract exactly. Use asymmetric open grouping, unequal emphasis, precise alignment, limited connectors, readable locked Chinese text and restrained editorial depth.

Keep all required Chinese text complete and unchanged. Allocate text space before scenes or decoration. Attach each text group to the corresponding business object, action, evidence, boundary or outcome. Page titles, subtitles, page numbers, Logo, headers, footers and master elements remain external.

Prefer recognizable electric-power, data, professional-service or operational objects and scenes. Use matte surfaces, light tonal separation, subtle crop and overlap. Icons are optional minor cues only.

Do not use equal card walls, icon arrays, generic dashboards, product posters, front-facing identifiable portraits, glossy 3D, glassmorphism, neon glow, multiple visual centers, invented readable microtext or unrelated decoration.
